tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// seng gdong rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa phrin las rnam rol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal gcig nyid las// gang 'dul rigs lnga'i skur snang seng ge'i zhal// bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gror gus btud nas// phrin las rnam par rol pa'i lam bzang dbye// 'di la gsum/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga las kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs shing rdo rje theg pa la lhag par gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha:sarba dharmā:swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod chen po brgyad dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs dbus sngau/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba rnams kyi nang du ru dra pho mo nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas par hūm̐ re re las/ dbus su rdo rje/ shar du gri gug byang du ral gri/ nub tu pad+ma/ lhor rin po che rnams so so'i rigs kyi kha dog can gyi hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag seng zhal dkar mo rngams shing rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ shar du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo seng zhal sngon mo can gri gug dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang nag seng zhal nag mo can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo seng zhal ser mo can lcags kyu dang gter bum 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo seng zhal dmar mo can rin po che dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dmar la zlum pa'i khro mo'i spyan gsum bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs shing sma ra dang smin ma las me stag 'phro ba/

dbu skra phyed gyen du brdzes shing dug sbrul nag pos bcings pa'i steng du rus pa'i 'khor lo dang rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ phyed thur du grol ba gsigs pa'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa spro ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhing lpags dang glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs 'phyang ba/ thal chen gyi tshom bu dang*/ khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris rnams kyis mtshan cing sbrul rigs lnga dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gru mo g.yon na rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgreng zhing brkyang bskum gar gyi rol pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ gdod nas rnam dag sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten 'das kyang tshul ni sna tshogs ston// rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur kun bzang mo// seng gdong rigs lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig rigs kyi kha dog can la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas las thams cad 'grub par bsams la/ thun mong du/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmāḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces dang*/ so so'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ de'i las sngags so// oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// oṃ sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de'i las sngags so// oṃ karma ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// oṃ sarba karma tsa tur mā ra ya phaṭa/ de'i las sngags so// oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// oṃ sarba bā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ de'i las sngags so// oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// oṃ sarba puṣ+ṭhiṃku ru oṃ/ de'i las sngags so// thun bsdu ba na/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdus te mnyam par gzhag de las slar yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i skur ldangs la dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug bsnyen pa byed na gtso bor yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi pa 'bum phrag bzhi sogs ji ltar rigs pa/ de'i phyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ de'i bcu cha la 'khor bzhi'i sngags dang*/ las sngags rnams ci rigs pa bzlas pas grub bo// gnyis pa rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnas dben par mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang por stegs bu'i dbus su ji skad bshad pa'i rdo rwa me ri dur khrod chos 'byung lha mtshan dang bcas pa bri ba'am/ ma grub na maṇ+ḍa lar rigs kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng mañdzi'i khar gtor ma dmar po zur gsum gtso 'khor lnga pa dar gdugs kyis brgyan/ de'i g.yas su bum pa bcud ldan/ g.yon du 'bul gtor/ mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa gsol gdab kyi bar bya/ de nas mdun gyi rten gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs bzlas pa gsol gdab kyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/

gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ'i byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod mthar/ seng gdong rigs lnga 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bum par seng gdong rigs lnga skad cig gis gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la yi ge bcu bzhi pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ rjes gnang bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa'am/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang lte bar hoḥyig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga sna tshogs pa'i mdog can 'phros/ rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ chos bshad ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar nas/ de la 'dir ye shes dang*/ las dang*/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen mo/ rig sngags 'chang ba tsam gyis kyang las thams cad 'grub par byed pa mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi skor la sgrub thabs dang man ngag gi bka' srol mang du yod pa las/ ring brgyud snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba nas bla ma sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las gsan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas mgon pos lam 'di'i sgrub pa lhur mdzad pa la brten nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dang*/ grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis dngos su zhal bstan cing*/ nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab mos dbugs dbyung bas grub pa chen po'i sa la gshegs par gyur/ de las paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs bral gsang ba sbyin gyi slob brgyud rnams kyis bzhes te mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad pa zab gsang snyan brgyud du grags pa'i chos sde la'ang*/

phyi nang gsang gsum las tshogs dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi bka' ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ 'dir thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa seng ge'i gdong can nang sgrub rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs lan gsum/ rgyud sdom pa dang ldan par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang mdun gyi rten gtor rdo rje srung ba'i gur dang dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung rigs kyi kha dog can re re'i lte bar ru tra dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du lam ste gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams lhar gsal 'debs pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐/ spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rigs lnga bzhugs pa la mos gus dung pa mdzad pas bla ma dang spyi bo'i ḍā ki nī rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi dur khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga la 'khor sha za ma mo bye ba 'bum sde bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams la thim/ de rnams 'od du ltem gyis zhu ste khyed rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang bcas rtsa sngags brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod cing me tog 'thor/

de ltar ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya ba sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdud 'dul sha za 'jigs pa'i sku// srog gcod ma mo khro zhing rngams// ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong can gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol// lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas las byung*// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// yang khyed rang rnams kyis bla ma dang lha la mos gus mdzad pas/ bla ma dang seng ge'i gdong can tha mi dad pa'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer gyis khrigs mer gyis gang bar mos te sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gong gi sngags rnams bzlar gzhug mthar slob dpon gyis/ seng gdong 'di la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes me tog 'thor/ de ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// slar yang bla ma dang lha la mos gus mdzad pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar phog snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nang du chos 'byung kha sbyor/ de'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la yid gtad pas pad+ma kha zum pa'i phyi rol du sngags kyi phreng bas lu gu rgyud du bcings par mos pa dang bcas 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su mnyam par 'jog mdzod/

de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// mtha' rten gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dngos su gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar// seng gdong mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyis// rdo rje slob ma'i 'gal rkyen sol// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par mdzod// ces dang sngags brjod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ dam tshig khas blang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams byas la slob ma gyes/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang nyid 'od gsal du bsdu zhing thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// gsum pa las kyi tshogs rab 'byams ni gzhan du shes la/ 'dir rigs lnga dang rjes su 'brel ba'i khyad par gyi las mdo tsam brjod na lnga las/ dang po rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la brten nas mchog sgrub pa ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma ru dra'i gdan gyi steng du rang skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can mthing nag seng zhal dkar mo can gri thod 'dzin cing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan cing skyil grung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams spyan drangs/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rang gi lus dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gyi spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo gri gug dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa/

mgrin par pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo lcags kyu dang gter bum/ thugs kar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo rdo rje dang thod khrag lte bar rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo rin po che dang ne'u le/ gsang bar las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang nag ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa rnams la so so'i rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gros bskor ba/ mig tu dam tshig mkha' 'gro nag mo phur bu dang thod khrag rna bar 'jig rten mkha' 'gro dmar mo dgra s+t+wa dang sbrul zhags/ snar sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ser mo cang te'u dang thod khrag khar thams cad mkha' 'gro g.yas tho ba dang*/ g.yon phubs 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang seng ge'i gdong can dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan cing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang rtsa khams dang ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phro bar gyur pa'i gtso mo lnga'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'dus snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor sbyangs te/ dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par bsams la/ lhar snang sgyu ma lta bu la sems rtse gcig tu gzung*/ de la mi gnas na mkha' 'gro spyi'i rtsa sngags yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi pa/ de'i phyed mkha' 'gro lnga'i sngags so// de'i phyed skye mched kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags bzla/ de'ang*/ oṃ sa ma ya ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sngags so// de bzhin tu/ oṃ lo ka ḍā ki nī sogs sbyar ba 'jig rten/ bi shwa ḍā kis sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ sarba ḍā kis thams cad mkha' 'gro'i sngags so// bzhi ka la las sbyor thun mong du/ oṃ sarba sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sbyar/ de lta bu'i ngag bzlas ci rigs pa'i mthar/ 'khor lo lnga'i mkha' 'gro so sor dmigs nas rlung bum pa can bzung zhing 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas rlung dbu mar zhugs nas thim pa'i rtags sogs nyams rtogs kyi yon tan skye bar 'gyur ro// thun gyi mjug tu mchod bstod 'dod don gsol/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du lud pa las phyi dkyil rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa dang*/ lus dkyil rnams la so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha phyi'i lha mo lus dkyil rnams la thim pas bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar/ mthar thig le 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'bar zhing 'phrig pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nyid kyang zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du thim par bsam la dbyings rigs bsres te mnyam par gzhag skabs su lus gnad byed bcings kyi sbyor ba dang bcas mig bar snang du har re gtad/ sems 'dzin med kyi ngang rlung rang babs su 'jog de las ldang ba na bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /gnyis pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la brten nas sdig sgrib zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ zhi ba'i thab spyi ltar 'du bya ba'am/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la sol mes kyang rung*/ rang gi mdun til lam yungs kar cung zad 'du bya/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi me thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar/ pad nyi ru tra'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro seng gdong can sku mdog dkar mo seng zhal sngon mo bzhad cing gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bzhengs pa'i lto ba rab tu yangs par 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ rtsibs rnams la rtsa sngags snying po las sngags rnams 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/

rang gzhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag 'dus pa'i ngo bo snying gar pam̐ nag po/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i me sbar/ des snying ga'i pam̐ sna sgor byung ba sdig pa'i rnam pas til la thim/ de nyid mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du phul ba lto ba'i sngags kyi 'khor lo 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa dang*/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbrail bas brgya rtsa la sogs pa dbul/ mthar mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro ma dgyes pa'i sku dang sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun char sprin 'khrugs pa las char 'bab pa bzhin byung*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thim pas sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs par bsam/ gtor ma yod na bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ sogs btags pas dbul/ gang ltar yang*/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ gdod nas rnam dag sogs kyi mthar/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed kyi lha rang la thim par bsam/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// gsum pa rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la brten nas tshe bsod rgyas pa'i man ngag ni/ tshe dang 'byor pa rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid legs par tshang ba'i ka pā la'i nang du sman sna dang dri bzang sin+dhūr rnams kyis byug snying po lnga dang*/ dūrba sogs tshe'i rdzas dang*/ dar zab rin chen 'bru sman sogs dpal can gyi rdzas kyis gtams/ mthing shog la gser gyis yi ge bcu bzhi pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i snying po/

las sngags/ gzhan yang tshe gzungs dang nor lha'i gzungs sogs bris pa'i shog dril dar ser po'i tshas dang*/ dri bzang bcas shing tog bi wa'i nang khengs par bcug pa dbus su gzhag mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ seng gdong rigs lnga'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i rjes/ mdun gyi rten bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba lha mi'i dpal 'byor rab tu rgyas pas gtams pa'i dbus su/ e e las chos 'byung ser po bsnol ma'i lte bar/ pad nyi ru dra'i steng du hūm̐ ser po las 'od zer 'phros 'dus rin po che hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin chen mkha' 'gro seng gdong can sku mdog ser mo seng zhal dmar mo bzhad cing nor bu dang ne'u le kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bzhengs pa/ 'od zer ser po spro ba dang bsdu bas rgyas pa'i las rab 'byams mdzad par gyur/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ ser po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ rtsa sngags snying po dang las sngags rnams sbrel te bzla/ mthar nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo smon bkra shis rgya cher brjod/ thod pa dar zab ser pos dril te mdzod kyi dbus su gzhag dus bzang por mchod bstod tshogs gtor phul bas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma la brten nas dbang gi me mchod bya ba ni/ sa dmar po'i stegs bur dbang gi me mchod bya ba ni/ sa dmar po'i stegs bur dbang gi thab spyi ltar bris pa'i steng du tsan+dan dmar po'am/ mdzo mo shing sogs rung ba'i bud shing zla gam du brtseg rang gi g.yas su zangs sder nang*/

gur gum dang*/ tsan+dan sogs dri dmar po/ glang sna sogs me tog dmar po/ byi ru dang zangs sogs rin po che dmar po/ dar sna/ 'bru sna/ zas sna/ shing tog lan tshwa sogs kyang li khris dmar por bsgyur ba dang*/ 'bri mog gis bsgyur ba'i mar khu bcas/ de tsam ma 'byor na 'bras lta bu'i 'bru kha dog dmar por byas pa dang*/ mar khu tsam la brten kyang rung*/ g.yon du gtor ma dmar po dang nyer spyod bcas bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas snying po'i sngags kyis me sbar/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang gi thab khung mtshan nyid rdzogs pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ e e las chos 'byung dmar po bsnol ma'i lte bar pad nyid ru dra'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros 'dus lcags kyu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma sku mdog dmar mo seng zhal ser mo bzhad cing lcags kyu dang gter bum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chos can zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bzhengs pa/ 'od zer dmar po spro ba dang bsdu bas rab 'byams dbang gi las mdzad par gyur/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas rdzas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsres te/ rtsa sngags snying po las sngags rnams sbrel bas brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi pad+ma mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i sku las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin can dpag tu med pa byung*/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas bde ba chen po'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bas mthong thos dran reg thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ slar yang bdag dang mdun bskyed las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud spyi dang*/ bye brag dmigs bya la phog pas chags pa'i zil gyis dmar lam song ste bdag nyid kyi dbang du 'dus par bsam la gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzhag

de nas slar yang mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ 'dod don gsol/ nongs pa bshags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs thab kyi lha rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ thal ba ri rtser rlung la bskur ba'am 'bab chu chen por dor ro// lnga pa karma mkha' 'gro ma la brten nas phyir zlog pa'i man ngag ni/ drag po'i las la shis pa'i dus su/ dur khrod kyi sa'am lcags kyi 'brub khung gi nang byad ma'i liṅga bzhug de'i steng mañdzi'i khar lcags sam bhan+dha'i snod du dmar gtor zur gsum sha khrag dang mtshe yungs sogs kyis brgyan pa'i mdun du drag po'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ bdag bskyed seng gdong rigs lnga'i bsgom bzlas sngon du song nas/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbus su e e las chos 'byung gru gsum ljang nag nyis brtsegs khrag mtsho khol zhing me rlung 'khrugs pa'i lte bar pad nyi ru dra'i gdan la hūm̐ ljang nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus ral gri hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las karma mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma sku mdog ljang nag ser zhal nag mo rngams shing ral gri dang thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan cing drag shul sṛn mo khros pa'i nyams can/ zhabs gnyis bskyang bskum gar gyi rol pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ srid zhi'i khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba/ khro bo khro mo dregs pa can gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spro zhing bsdu bas drag po'i las rab 'byams mdzad pa'i skur gyur/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod bstod bya/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ ljang nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer me dang mtshon cha khro mo'i sprin phung 'phro pas gdon bgegs 'byung bo tshar bcad par bsams la/

rtsa sngags/ snying po/ las sngags rnams sbrel te bzlas mthar slar yang mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka nas spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis dmigs bya dbang med du bkug nas gzugs brnyan la bstims par bsams la/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i bden pa'i mthus// dgra bgegs 'byung po byad ma kun// gzugs brnyan 'di la myur du khug /ces bden stobs dang*/ rtsa sngags sogs sngags rnams kyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nān sha trūn dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod cing dmigs pa drag tu bya/ de nas/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces brjod pas/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes dwangs ma a yig gi rnam pas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar thim/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang la 'dus/ mdun bskyed las nad mtshon dug gi char babs pas gzugs phung rdul du brlags par bsams la/ rtsa sngags dang las sngags kyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug bsad gris dum bur gtub pa dang*/ sha dum/ khrag thig btsong sgog lan tshwa/ thang phrom sogs dang sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ sarba bigh+nān sha trun ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī siṃ ha mu khā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ gdod nas rnam dag sogs nas/ karma mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ las kyi seng gdong ḍā ki 'khor bcas kun// dgra bgegs sha ri khrag mtsho'i gtor ma bzhes// bstan la gnod pa'i bdug can dpung dang bcas// tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/

de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pa'i mthar phyir zlog pa'i las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ 'jigs byed dpa' mo chen mo ni// rtsub 'gyur las kyi seng gdong ma// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed// 'khor bcas do nub mthu rtsal skyed// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// 'gal rkyen bar du gcod byed pa'i// bdud dang log 'dren mi mthun tshogs// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /zlog cig sgyur cig sa ma ya// rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// byad dang byur kha rbod gtong rnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu rnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /glo bur ye 'drog drug cu dang*// gtor kha phur kha zug pa rnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /gshin rje'i khrom kha zug pa dang*// rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba rnams// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /ma mo'i khrag zor gru mtshon 'phen// klu srin kha rlangs mdze nad kun// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du zlog /gzhan yang mi mthun bar chad rnams// zlog cig sgyur cig dgra la zlog /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul bzhin du// rtsad nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces dang*/ rtsa sngags dang snying po'i mthar/ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog ces brjod cing thal mo brdab/ de lta bu tshar drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs kyi mthar mdun bskyed la mchod cing bstod/ oṃ badz+ra ud+dhiṣ+ṭha/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs rten dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ slar yang zlog pa'i phrin las bcol bas gtor ma nad mtshon dug gi char chen por gyur pa dgra bo'i yul du glog 'khyug pa ltar babs pa'i rjes su nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs te dgra bgegs dpung bcas kha phung rjes med du btang bar bsams la dgra phyogs su 'phang*/

dmigs med kyi lta ba'i ngang yun ring du mnyam par gzhag de nas bdag nyid lhar gsal ba 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par bsam/ slar yang rdo rje seng gdong ma'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i srung ba'i gur gyis gtams par bsams la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas srung ba dang*/ dge bsngo shis brjod rgyas par bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// 'di ni bsnyen pa thim zhing dmigs pa gsal bas lan gsum byas na byad phur rbod gtong ji ltar che yang zlog nges pa'i zab rgya can no// de ltar sgrub rjes las tshogs dang bcas pa yig rnying rnams la gzhir byas te don tshang snying por dril ba'o// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung grub pa'i gtam// rgya che'i snying po phrin las rnam rol ba// legs bshad nyi ma gsar pa'i gzi 'od kyis// sa gsum bkra shis snang ba rgyas par shog// /ces pa'ang tshul 'di'i gdams skor gyi yig cha snga phyi mang du thos shing mthong ba la brten nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
